notes.title: Astro Duel 2 is Available Now!
notes.notes:
KABOOM - Astro Duel 2 is finally out!!

If you haven’t heard, Astro Duel 2 is a new take on platform fighting, combining space and ground combat at the same time!

After over 7 years of work, we’re thrilled to share Astro Duel 2 with you. For launch week, you can pick it up for a [b]10% launch discount[/b]!

We’re also released [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R40O_oYvxVI]a fresh video[/url] revealing our new [i]Cash Grab[/i] mode, which is included and unlockable at launch!

[previewyoutube=qyfAGY7QmM4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We’re headed to PAX West to debut Astro Duel 2!
notes.notes:
We’re headed to PAX West this week and are so excited to finally do an in-person event!

Find us at booth #1526. We’ll be showing off Astro Duel 2 for the first time. And maybe we’ll play some classic Astro Duel while we're out there?

Are you coming out too? We’d love to say hi and also show you what we’ve been cooking up!

Cheers,
Rusty

notes.notes:

notes.title: Engine Upgrade: Modern Gamepads Now Supported!
notes.notes:
Got a fancy new DualSense or Switch Pro gamepad? They now work in the latest update!

I've been upgrading the game engine and decided to fix some lingering bugs and issues too. This update coincides with the iPad and Apple TV versions, which just got keyboard support along with the changes below.

[list]
[*] Added support for many new gamepads including Switch Pro and PS5
[*] Added rumble support for newer Playstation, Switch and Xbox gamepads
[*] Fixed controller D-pad not properly working
[*] Using the Ship Dash no longer consumes ammo
[*] Added a new Ship Dash tip
[*] Pilots are now killed instantly in Ship Hunters and Team Deathmatch
[*] Added rings to the Repulse level to show the push-back force
[*] Fixed display bugs on the scoreboard
[/list]
To everyone still enjoying Astro Duel: Thanks for playing!

-Rusty

[h5]If you have problems with this patch, please fill out the [url=https://forms.gle/Fq1VjH2q4ydkGKjh6]Bug Report Form[/url] to let me know what went wrong![/h5]

notes.title: Maps 'n Mods Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cJxVmk7.gif[/img]

Three new maps and three new modifiers headline this update.

Here's the full change log:

- Added Dance level: four square barriers move in sync around the center.
- Added Loop level: a circular conveyor belt pushes everything around.
- Added Maze level: lots of destructible terrain!
- Added a Powerups modifier. Now powerups can be disabled.
- Added an Unlimited Dash modifier. When enabled dashing will no longer cost ammo, but the dash cooldown will be increased from 0.5 to 0.85 seconds. 
- Added a Super Dash modifier.
- Can now cancel a Jouster boost (or the new Super Dash) by pressing the Powerup button
- Starting powerup modifier now shows which powerup is selected before battle. Useful for the "Random" starting powerup option.
- Fixed rare pilot "self-kill" bug
- Fixed Dash not working while turning with Keyboard controls
- Renamed game mode "Headhunters" to be "Ship Hunters"
- Renamed game mode "Pilot Execution" to be "Pilot Hunters"
- Default game mode is now Pilot Hunters
- Reorganized and renamed some of the modifiers in the Advanced Setup menu.

Hope you all dig the update!
